comment: Menu item names, given in the order the menu builds them: Crush, Bank, FM, VCA on the Wavetable VCO and pitch, decay, sample, volume on Pico Drums. Every one of them prints with a trailing space, colon and space before its checkmark; the lines drop that. All three menus are the module's own, built in appendContextMenu. Fusion Delay has no menu of its own. NO NUMBER HAS BEEN ADDED IN THIS PASS. The counts that appear — 64 samples, 16 banks, 16 waves, eight waveforms — were already in the entry and rest on the shipped sample files and the census parameter ranges, not on the hardware manuals. See NUMBER-CHECK.md.
